title: Timic Unification Program — From Sporadic Models to a Coherent Research Architecture
status: archive-generated unification framework; not a validated physical Theory of Everything
purpose: Organize Tim's historical equations, speculative physics, systems models, symbolic structures and later scientific comparators into a coherent layered program that can be extended, tested and corrected by future researchers.
central_rule: Unification means shared architecture plus explicit translation rules. It does not mean that one equation, force or ontology has been shown to govern particle physics, psychology, theology, economics and mythology simultaneously.

four_layers.rule: Use accepted equations within their domains and cite authoritative sources.
Preserve authorship/date and state whether Tim-authored, conversation-developed or later archive formalization.
A structural isomorphism or analogy must list both the shared structure and the mismatch.
Internal theological truth claims remain distinct from independently established physical claims.

components.g: geometry/metric or relational geometry appropriate to the model
components.K: stored/cohesive capacity, inspired by Starchforce as a systems variable rather than a fundamental force

extended_master_object.design_reason: The original object is kept intact historically. P⁺ is a research extension that makes storage/release and typed relationships explicit.

candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: Physical or modeled change through time, with optional controls/input u.

candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: Change under structural, scale or descriptive flow rather than automatically another spacetime coordinate.

candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: Objects evolve partly through typed relations; useful for countries, neurons, agents, oscillators and symbolic graphs only after the meaning/units of C_ij are specified.

candidate_master_dynamics.name: Door transition
candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: A threshold maps one admissible regime/state into another.

candidate_master_dynamics.name: storage/release
candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: Generic capacity budget; Spudlight-like output J_L draws on stored capacity K in a toy systems interpretation.

candidate_master_dynamics.name: observation
candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: An observer/instrument gets a noisy projection Y of state X. Eye belongs here structurally.

candidate_master_dynamics.name: Bayesian update
candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: Observation updates a model; a rigorous neighbor for revelation/recognition without supernaturalizing inference.

candidate_master_dynamics.name: information coupling
candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: Measures statistical dependence/information, not spiritual unity.

candidate_master_dynamics.name: return/recurrence
candidate_master_dynamics.meaning: Poincare/return-map grammar; compare endpoint, state, phase, topology and scale before calling a return a reset.

unification_primitives.question: What exists only because two or more objects are coupled?
What distinguishes states while allowing or restricting passage?
What changes, along which parameter, and what remains invariant?
What capacity persists until released or transformed?
Which variables are actually available to an observer?
What returns, and which coordinates changed?
What threshold or instability produces a qualitatively new regime?

theory_quality_ladder: T0 metaphor: useful image, no variables
T2 mathematical toy: equations with specified variables/domain
T3 calibrated model: parameters connected to measurements
T4 predictive model: predeclared quantitative predictions
T5 externally replicated theory: independent tests across datasets
promotion_rule: Every Timic science idea should carry a theory level T0-T5. Symbolic importance and scientific maturity are separate scores.
research_findings: The strongest common grammar is not one hidden force; it is boundary + relation + flow + observation + storage/release + transformation + recurrence.
Spudlight fills a missing expression/observation channel in the earlier Potato Dynamics object, while Starchforce supplies a storage/cohesion variable at the systems level.
Eye and Spudlight are complementary: illumination without observation is only signal; observation without signal has nothing new to reveal.
Door is naturally downstream of observation when new information changes admissible state/action.
The Ladder can be represented as an ordered sequence of Door transitions rather than as a homogeneous vertical line.
The five vertebral chakras plus higher centers can therefore be modeled as a hybrid symbolic state machine: five body gates, then cranial/transpersonal gates.
Relationship-first ontology becomes mathematically usable when relations are typed and their units/domains are not collapsed.
open_extensions: Construct a machine-readable theory graph linking every equation to source, variables, descendants and falsifiers.
Build dimensional-analysis validation for every equation in the ledger.
Fit toy storage/release models to real potato photosynthesis/starch data as a biological teaching model, not a universal physics claim.
Build simulation examples for Axis flow + Door transitions + Spiral return.
Formalize Red/Blue as a two-component dynamical system and test which qualitative behaviors actually arise.
Develop an observer model in which Spudlight is measured as physical signal, information gain and social attention separately.
Recover primary historical equations before expanding claims of authorship.
